question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Chief Minister of Jharkhand, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hemant Soren.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemant Soren** is the current **Chief Minister of Jharkhand** as of **November 2022.**
 
• In addition, he serves as the **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha's **acting president.
 
• Jharkhand is a state in eastern India, bordered by **Bihar to the north,** **Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh** to the west, **Odisha** to the south, and **West Bengal** to the east.
 
• The state was formed in** 2000**, after being carved out of Bihar, and has its capital at** Ranchi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raghubar Das** was the **Chief Minister of Jharkhand** from **2014 to 2019**, before being replaced by Hemant Soren.
 
• **Amit Shah** is a prominent national-level politician in India, belonging to the ruling **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP).
 
 
• He is currently serving as the** Union Home Minister of India**, and has never been the Chief Minister of Jharkhand.
